scope: T0_BRC companion tooling for exact finite count-centered carry, valuation holonomy, symbolic reciprocal-wavelet geometry, Mobius-log deconvolution, and hard-prime skeleton/thickness diagnostics

tools.input_contract: Positive integer finite scales and branch indices; exact integer/Fraction valuation state; signed Mobius-log data only through the formal observer/deconvolution surface.
tools.output_contract: Exact carry counts, count-centered rational coefficients, prime-valuation holonomy, symbolic gamma/log forms, exact Mobius-divisor deconvolution identities, and hard-prime n-th-power skeleton/thickness coordinates.
tools.reuse_rule: Use when a selected problem has doubling-carry branch geometry and requires observer-safe count centering or valuation-holonomy preservation before logarithmic readout. Reuse the exact finite surface unchanged before deriving analytic asymptotics.
